about: The fixed views every look step is judged on. Camera at eye, aimed at look, field of view fov, game clock in hours. Same shots, same order, every time. World coordinates as WorldBuilder builds them: lake water spans x -110..110 and z -80..80 at y 0, ground top is y 1, the dock runs from the south shore north at x 0 (z 80 to 34), the stands and home pond sit south of the dock (z 96 to 106). Cedar Creek runs north to south along x -230 (riffle z 30..75, deep pool z -70..-10), entered through the gate at x -158. (The first baseline on 11/26/2026 was shot while the whole Lake model sat 6 west, 10 up and 55 north of these; the shots were moved by the same amount on 11/26/2026 so they frame the same places.)
